item.description:
- Kept the welcome and scanning title centered at compact window widths.
- Audited English, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, Brazilian Portuguese, and Arabic copy. Fixed malformed counters, photographic terms, translated product names, English fallbacks, accessibility labels, and localized export controls. Finder service labels now use the same catalogs. Damaged templates fall back safely before inserting filenames; Arabic numeric ranges retain their reading order.
- Replaced the bottom status strip with a floating Liquid Glass photo zoom control. Save status stays in the toolbar; its popover holds filter details, review completion, and tips. Older macOS versions retain a material fallback. Matched zoom glass to the toolbar height, removed the autosave explainer, and fixed sideways Browser/Grid scrolling caused by the scrollbar gutter, including short grids that previously reserved the gutter twice. Added checked Gallery/Grid choices and shortcut hints to the View menu, with compact Zoom In/Out actions for Grid. Double-clicking anywhere on the floating zoom control returns the photo to Fit. Menu shortcut hints also cover Command Palette, Rescan, Export, Undo, Clear All Decisions, and photo sizes.
- Combined Settings into one scrolling page with consistent sections, the link to the getting-started guide, version and update controls, and optional support. Clarified that Louppe is always free and open source.
- Added optional tips: Apple in-app purchases in the App Store build and the author’s Revolut page for direct downloads.
- Made Filter sections consistent, kept cue rules and a numeric burst interval in Settings, and aligned links under Louppe info. - Made Filter disclosure headers clickable across their full padded rows. Kept the getting-started guide in Help, with one Settings link and the tips toggle in their own section, separate from Capture bursts. - Added Quality cues and Capture bursts to Filter, with consistent Browser/Grid badges and compact values in Info. Near-white and near-black rules have independent thresholds and reset controls; changing rules reuses measurements. - Made burst detection use scanned dates without hashing photos or decoding previews. Preserved fractional capture times, time zones, and estimated dates. - Opened changed-file sessions without discarding earlier decisions. Identical copies and returning originals recover verified decisions; older sessions offer explicit restoration and retain recovery history. Clear All Decisions and Undo stay cleared when background checks finish and after reopening. - Kept background checks bounded, paused them during file work and Quit, and indexed recovery lookups so ordinary decisions avoid folder-wide scans. - Reduced pairing and review-sort work, kept Gallery loading independent of thumbnail backlog, and retired cancelled image requests. Moved group membership off the UI thread, removed background RAW dwell, cached image-check coverage, and made saved sessions smaller while preserving recovery and file safety. - Reduced quality-check bookkeeping, paced remaining-folder checks with Low Power and thermal backoff, and kept Pause in effect until Resume. Prioritized Info histogram requests while background checks use utility work. - Made large-folder Quality Cue filters faster by retaining compact numeric matches and updating only newly measured photos. Rule changes and replacement files invalidate matches; ordering, selection and physical ratings are preserved. - Updated saved sessions to format 7 to preserve recovery history; version 1.10 cannot open sessions saved by 1.11.
